## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY_TLT NEUTRAL and HYG_LQD NEUTRAL; equity internals show SPY (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit easing: HYG (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.37% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD ↑ rising. Fear lower: VXX (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-looser: TLT (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY while HYG/LQD are ABOVE TREND, suggesting liquidity mild easing and mixed duration preference.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +22.74%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +11.11%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND — Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?  
US strength apparent: SPY (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +7.71%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND, while EM/China are also strong: EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +9.65%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative risk back: ARKK (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +11.61%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +4.63% | 1M: +12.00%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +3.99% | 1M: +8.61%) ABOVE TREND — appetite healthy.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial/precious metals strength: CPER (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND — reflation bias.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND, while natural gas shows short-term bounce: UNG (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -13.61%) RECOVERY.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (8/11) and SPY/QQQ ABOVE TREND validate equity leadership; DIVERGENCE: TLT in RECOVERY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: -0.11%) and pockets of commodity RECOVERY signal minor cross-asset friction — overall MINOR divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposures showing strength (XLK, SOXX, ARKK, IWM) and monitor credit via HYG/LQD; reduce exposure to energy exposure showing weakness (XLE, BNO) and watch duration signals (TLT).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation above recent highs; BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.57% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND — watch for further underperformance.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND; BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND and CANE (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF spread (monitor 2.0 pivot for style swing), SPY short-term breakout above recent consolidation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL — Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and momentum (XLK, SOXX, ARKK) along with small caps (IWM) are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: duration signal in RECOVERY (TLT) and persistent energy weakness (XLE) — monitor for cross-asset spillovers.
